items.q: I used to work at the Central Plaza. He said, "You're the only one.

ctx.x: I used to work at the Central Plaza. He said, "You're the only one. The rest of them, they're in there, and they ain't watching what they're doing." But you got to respect the Lion, 'cause the Lion is movin'.
